name: Dragonmaw Rumors
summary: The Deathstalkers seek clearer word about Dragonmaw magic rumored in the Wetlands. You are sent to meet their agent in the hills above the clan's camp.

sections.title: Whispers in the Wetlands
sections.body: A Deathstalker in the Wetlands needs your help as rumors gather around the Dragonmaw clan. They are said to command magic that binds dragons, and whispers claim they prepare a display of that power. Broken symbols offered no firm proof, so you are sent to meet an agent in the hills above their camp.

faq.q: What are the Dragonmaw rumored to be doing?
faq.answer: The rumor says the Dragonmaw are preparing a display of magic strong enough to make dragons serve.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers need help?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers have only broken symbols and uncertain whispers about the Dragonmaw, so an agent needs assistance in the hills above the clan's camp.
The agent is in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp in the Wetlands.

faq.q: What did the broken symbols reveal?
faq.answer: The broken symbols carried only uncertain whispers about a rumored Dragonmaw display of magic.

faq.q: What happens when you meet the agent?
faq.answer: The Deathstalker agent will reveal the next steps when you meet her in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
